name: Interaction and Interfaces
description: The course will provide a foundation on interaction design with a project-based pedagogy, with students working on an interaction design opportunity/problem rooted in real-life context. Principles of interaction design, elements of interaction design, user research for interaction designers, journey mapping, information architecture, components and principles of good user interface (UI) design, micro-interactions, low and high fidelity prototyping, design systems, usability, accessibility, responsive design, cognitive and affective UX, storytelling and documentation.
